intro.notch: I live up here, in the notch.
notch.press: Press control, command, K, and I'm there, over anything you're doing.
notch.card: That's the card. Chat, notes, and the agent you're about to make.
agent.first: First, let's make you an agent.
agent.cli: Claude Code is already on this Mac. One click. Or paste an OpenRouter key for any model.
agent.key: It talks to any model through OpenRouter. Paste a key, give it a name, and it's yours.
agent.name: Give it a name.
task.watch: Now watch. I'll ask it something for you.
task.asking: It's asking before it touches your Mac.
task.allow: That's always your call. Press Allow.
task.fail: Your agent couldn't answer just now.
task.standin: So I'll show you the shape of it with a stand-in.
drive.face: There's a third face. Computer Use.
drive.tell: Tell it what you want done, and it drives. Reading the screen, clicking, typing.
drive.stop: You can stop it any time. Try it. Press Stop.
drive.stopped: Stopped, between actions. Nothing else happens. You're always the one in charge.
drive.auto: I'll do it. Stopped, between actions. Nothing else happens. That's always your call.
drive.done: Done. A real run asks for Accessibility first, then does exactly that.
finale.back: Control, command, K brings me back. Anywhere, any time.
